Quick triage notes from infra/runtime:
- Alerts triggered: host-level CPU and 95th percentile token latency on hosted-gpu-pool-7 between 09:44-10:15 PDT.
- Early signal: prefix cache miss ratio spiked on a subset of model shards (shard ids 7/8/9). We saw >40% eviction rate vs normal ~2-3%.
- We have logs indicating a large background reindex job kicked off from an internal batch pipeline which caused aggressive memory pressure and triggered our LRU prefix eviction policy. That in turn caused cold KV lookups and higher token generation latency for affected requests.

Mitigations applied so far:
1) Throttled the internal reindex job at 10:22 PDT (job now paused).
2) Adjusted eviction sensitivity on hosted-gpu-pool-7 to favor pinned prefixes for customer-critical routes (applied 10:28 PDT).
3) Enabled temporary routing fallback for FastLane traffic to a sibling pool (hosted-gpu-pool-3) with warmed caches at 10:33 PDT.

We're still seeing residual p95 uplift while caches rewarm (expected 20–35 minutes depending on prefix hit distribution). Marcus is collecting detailed prefix-eviction-logs.txt and we'll attach.

Aditya
Sr Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Update for FastLane:
Hi Amelia — small update from runtime team. We confirmed the eviction spike was correlated with an internal high-memory maintenance task that expanded in parallel across several host groups. Two things to be aware of:

- Impact: requests that rely on long-prefix KV caching (search-autocomplete routes) saw the worst tail latency. Short prompt routes (chat-like) were less affected.
- Temporary workaround: we routed your production API key to a warmed sibling pool and increased per-route cache pinning for your top 20 prefixes. That should reduce p95 significantly for the most common queries.

We expect cache rewarm to bring p95 closer to normal in ~25 minutes; p99 may take longer if there are low-frequency prefixes. We will follow up once we confirm metrics back to baseline.

If you'd like, we can enable a per-customer sticky routing rule to keep your traffic on warmed pools while we harden the eviction policy.

—Marissa
